Steering axles (value or referenced annex required)
Anti-lock braking configurations (value or referenced annex required)
Wheelbase, track, centre of gravity height (value or referenced annex required)
Wheel type (single or twin) and tyre type (e.g. structure, category of use, size) (value or referenced annex required)
Management of the engine or any other source(s) of motive power e.g.Torque Management, control of fuel supply etc. (value or referenced annex required)
Pneumatic circuits System schematics including anti-lock braking configurations associated with the trailer types defined in paragraph 6.2.1. of this annex. (value or referenced annex required)
Maximum GVW kg (for rigid vehicles) (value or referenced annex required)
Manufacturer's engine model code (as marked on the engine, or other means of identification) (value or referenced annex required)
Location of engine model code and engine serial number on block / crankcase (drawing to be attached) (value or referenced annex required)
Drawings of combustion chamber and piston crown and, in the case of positive ignition engine, piston rings: (value or referenced annex required)
Engine Power Table (value or referenced annex required)
Radiator drawing(s) (value or referenced annex required)
Description and drawings of inlet pipes and their accessories (plenum chamber, heating device, additional air intakes, etc.): (value or referenced annex required)
Intake manifold description including dimensional drawings and/or photographs): (value or referenced annex required)
Air filter, Dimensional drawings (value or referenced annex required)
Description and Dimensional drawing of the exhaust manifold: (value or referenced annex required)

Effective volume of exhaust-system (specify the tolerance & range) in liters (from exhaust manifold / TC outlet to tail pipe end), Enclose the exhaust system dimensional drawing and indicate the volume of each parts clearly (value or referenced annex required)
Internal diameter of exhaust pipe (mm)(min) (value or referenced annex required)
Device for recycling crankcase gases (description and drawings): (value or referenced annex required)
Dimensions (mm) and shape of the catalytic converter(s) (volume, etc.): (value or referenced annex required)
Diagram indicating the arrangement and Positioning of the catalytic converter(s) (place and reference distances in the exhaust system): (value or referenced annex required)
Location of the particulate trap (reference distances in the exhaust line): (value or referenced annex required)
Written description and/or drawing of the Malfunction Indicator (MI): (value or referenced annex required)
List and purpose of all components monitored by the OBD system: (value or referenced annex required)
Written description (general working principles) for: (value or referenced annex required)
Catalyst monitoring (value or referenced annex required)
Particulate traps monitoring: (value or referenced annex required)
Electronic fueling system monitoring: (value or referenced annex required)
NOx control system monitoring (SCR/LNT/NOx absorber): (value or referenced annex required)
Other components monitored by the OBD system: (value or referenced annex required)
Criteria for MI activation (fixed number of driving cycles or statistical method): (value or referenced annex required)
List of all OBD output codes and formats used (with explanation of each): (value or referenced annex required)
OBD Communication protocol standard (value or referenced annex required)
A description of the type of the OBD demonstration cycle used for the original type-approval of the vehicle for the component monitored by the OBD system. (value or referenced annex required)

A comprehensive document describing all sensed components with the strategy for fault detection and MI activation (fixed number of driving cycles or statistical method), including a list of relevant secondary sensed parameters for each component monitored by the OBD system. A list of all OBD output codes and format used (with an explanation of each) associated with individual emission related power-train components and individual non-emission related components, where monitoring of the component is used to determine MI activation. In particular, a comprehensive explanation for the data given in service $05 Test ID $21 to FF and the data given in service $06 shall be provided. In the case of vehicle types that use a communication link in accordance with ISO 15765-4 "Road vehicles – Diagnostics on Controller Area Network (CAN) – Part 4: Requirements for emissions- related systems", a comprehensive explanation for the data given in service $06 Test ID $00 to FF, for each OBD monitor ID supported, shall be provided. (value or referenced annex required)
The information required by this paragraph may, for example, be defined by completing a table as follows, which shall be attached to this annex: (value or referenced annex required)
Parameters defining the OBD family (to be attached) (in reference with AIS 137) (value or referenced annex required)
Make and Identification Number: (value or referenced annex required)
Schematic Diagram of Engine cooling system (value or referenced annex required)
A list, specifying the parts which constitute the headlamp cleaner and drawings thereof, (e.g. pumps, nozzles, valves, motors and wipers); (value or referenced annex required)

Description and drawings/photographs of the shapes and constituent materials of the part of the body forming the engine compartment and the part of the passenger compartment nearest to it: (value or referenced annex required)

Drawings or photographs of the position of the metal components housed in the engine compartment (e.g. heating appliances, spare wheel, air filter, steering mechanism, etc.): (value or referenced annex required)

List of all Electrical components, which include Broadband EMI sources (like HAVC Motor, Wiper Motor, Window motor and Horn etc.) The list shall include Device name, Make/s and Part No. /Type ID/Drawing No (value or referenced annex required)
Components placed in Engine compartment (value or referenced annex required)

(value or referenced annex required)

Make and Identification Number: (value or referenced annex required)
Schematic Diagram of Engine cooling system (value or referenced annex required)
A list, specifying the parts which constitute the headlamp cleaner and drawings thereof, (e.g. pumps, nozzles, valves, motors and wipers); (value or referenced annex required)

Description and drawings/photographs of the shapes and constituent materials of the part of the body forming the engine compartment and the part of the passenger compartment nearest to it: (value or referenced annex required)

Drawings or photographs of the position of the metal components housed in the engine compartment (e.g. heating appliances, spare wheel, air filter, steering mechanism, etc.): (value or referenced annex required)

List of all Electrical components, which include Broadband EMI sources (like HAVC Motor, Wiper Motor, Window motor and Horn etc.) The list shall include Device name, Make/s and Part No. /Type ID/Drawing No (value or referenced annex required)
